bullets: Powerful yet Compact: Boasting a 1,500W AC output and a 3,000W surge peak, the Solar Generator 1000 V2 can power multiple appliances, including AC units, fridges, and electric pots. PD 100W fast USB-C charging ensures a rapid charging speed, even without power adapters.

Smart App Control: Effortlessly switch between different charging modes with Jackery’s App—including one hour emergency charging from 0 to 100%, 30 dB quiet overnight charging mode, and energy efficiency mode. Maximize the freedom to adjust the power station to meet your needs.

B0GTQ7BHVL.title: OUPES Mega 1 Lite Portable Power Station 1024Wh 2000W (4500W Surge)
bullets: [Unmatched Charging Speed] Experience the future of power with OUPES Mega 1 Lite. Featuring a massive 1400W AC input, this power station recharges from 0 to 100% in just 46 minutes. Never wait hours again; get back to your adventure or secure your home backup in the time it takes to have a lunch break.

[Powerful 2000W AC Output] With a rated 2000W output and a 4500W surge capacity, the Mega 1 Lite easily handles 99% of high-power appliances. From your coffee maker and microwave to hair dryers and power tools, this unit provides reliable, pure sine wave power wherever you go.

[Dual 140W PD USB-C Ports] Stay productive anywhere. Equipped with two USB-C PD 140W ports, you can quickly charge your laptop, or smartphones at maximum speed without needing bulky adapters. Includes 9 versatile ports to power all your devices simultaneously.

[Seamless UPS Home Backup] Protect your sensitive electronics. With a <20ms UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) switchover, the Mega 1 Lite ensures your CPAP machine, router, or computer stays running during sudden power outages, preventing data loss and discomfort.

[Smart App Control] Take command from your fingertips. Use the smart APP to monitor real-time power usage, adjust charging speeds (700W slow charge supported), and toggle output ports remotely. Stay informed about battery health and performance via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi.

[Extreme Portability] Power that moves with you. Weighing only 26.7 lbs and featuring an ergonomic handle, the Mega 1 Lite is lightweight for its 1024Wh capacity. It fits easily in your trunk, making it the ideal companion for road trips, tailgating, and RVing.

[Lightning-Fast 800W Solar Input] Harness the sun with industry-leading efficiency. Supporting up to 800W solar input via the Anderson port, you can fully recharge in just 70 minutes using 3*240W solar panels. Perfect for eco-friendly off-grid living and long-term camping trips.

[Long-Lasting LiFePO4 Battery] Safety and longevity come first. Built with premium LiFePO4 battery cells, the Mega 1 Lite offers over 3,500+ cycles to 80% capacity, lasting up to 10 years of regular use. It's a sustainable energy solution designed for durability and peace of mind.

[Whisper-Quiet Operation] Enjoy the silence of nature. Unlike noisy gas generators, the Mega 1 Lite operates with minimal fan noise, making it perfect for use inside tents, bedrooms, or during nighttime sleep without any disturbance.
[What’s Included] Your purchase includes: 1* OUPES Mega 1 Lite Portable Power Station, 1* AC Charging Cable, 1* Car Charging Cable, 1* User Manual, and a comprehensive 5-year warranty.
